description: “I’m probably the number one person who says we need to look at this process,” Secretary of State Shirley Weber told POLITICO in an interview, calling California an “outlier” in matters like the relatively low threshold to qualify a recall. “The process we have is old, it is difficult to implement, it is expensive, and it’s probably not very fair to everyone.”
title: [Politico] California elections chief wants recall overhaul, possibly as soon as 2022 - Shirley Weber for Secretary of State
